forecasts.reason: 12 more frozen steps at ~10 ms save ~0.12 s; earlier anneal likely costs ~0.1 pp, which is near the dial rate. A 3-seed check can't resolve 0.08 pp.
~35 group-1-detached 28 px steps at ~7 ms save ~0.25 s; halving stem updates mid-run costs ~0.15 pp (~1.7 s/pp), which is borderline against the 0.10 pp gate.
Only ~10 steps move to frozen (~0.085 s). Interpolating E037 gives a ~0.1–0.15 pp loss, a rate worse than the dial; the mechanism will stay ambiguous.
Elementwise kernels are 27% of a step and ReLU removes only part of their bytes. The projected saving is likely 1.5–3%, so the gate probably closes the branch.
Depends on the cuts passing their gates. A +0.25 epoch top-up (~0.15 s) roughly refunds a ~0.1 pp loss; net time ~-3%, accuracy near the tip, with seeds 0–2 a coin flip.

cruxes: On seeds 13–32 against a same-build E049 baseline, does the 85% group-2 freeze lose 0.08 pp or less? This decides whether the freeze cascade keeps beating the epoch dial's ~1.5 s/pp.
Does intermittent stem backward in the 28 px phase (the largest remaining per-step saving, ~0.25 s) lose 0.10 pp or less? Or does group 1 need gradients on every step before the 32 px switch?
What is the tip's unselected population mean (0.7535 vs 0.754), and is the build deterministic? This sets how much margin any time cut can spend before the PCIe judge's rebuild fails the bar.
structured_output.world_model:
W3 (cost lens), after E051, forecasting I083–I087.

Tip: E049, 5.198 s, population mean about 0.7535–0.754. Time model: 0.25 s + Σ steps × per-step cost (32 px 32 ms, 28 px 26 ms, 24 px 21 ms, 20 px 16 ms). The stem freeze saves ~27% of a step and the group-2 freeze ~10 ms per step.

Every remaining cut moves steps onto truncated variants:
- I083: −0.12 s for about −0.1 pp.
- I084: −0.25 s for about −0.15 pp.
- I085: −0.085 s for about −0.12 pp.

The dial buys accuracy back at ~1.5 s/pp, so stacking with a top-up nets only about 2–3% time. ReLU is bytes-limited and likely saves under 3%.

Noise: ±0.25 pp across rebuilds, so a 3-seed check can't resolve the gates.
